input.draft:
While building a campus shuttle tracker with three classmates, I wrote the parser that turned inconsistent arrival messages into a single feed. Reviewing those errors made me interested in how software can stay useful when its inputs are unreliable.

I built the the replay tool that let us investigate failures using saved messages. Our system eliminated delays for everyone on campus.

In graduate school, I want to study distributed systems. Your university has outstanding resources that will help me grow.
